6369.title: Threadless panel rejects host-file navigation
6369.rootCauseOneLine: The scoped host-target branch rejects requests without a thread or environment and lacks project-root mapping to core's workspace preview.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — targets the observed root cause
prReviews.topFinding: Adds workspace-root context and host-to-workspace mapping; no linked PR code was run.

6369.proposedFix: Resolve the compose workspace host/folder and map contained same-host targets to core's relative workspace-preview request; preserve rejection outside that context.
6369.caveats: Controller-level reproduction repeated in two clean trusted clones; live plugin UI and file I/O not exercised. New thread can have an owner thread when reusing an environment. Existing open PR #6370 prevents a duplicate fix. Test and output are inline per reports repository policy.
